items.prompt: A colleague asks if you're ready for the big project starting Monday. Which reply fits best?
options: Ready? I've sketched the plan, let's hit the ground running!
Yes, I'm ready. We'll take it one careful step at a time.
items.target: Ready? I've sketched the plan, let's hit the ground running!

items.prompt: Your trainer asks how you feel before the race. Which reply fits best?
options: My legs are twitching to go, I could run it twice!
My legs are shaking and I keep thinking I'll trip.
items.target: My legs are twitching to go, I could run it twice!

items.prompt: A friend asks what you're doing this Saturday. Which reply fits best?
options: Painting the shed, fixing the bike, then football. Let's go!
Painting the shed, fixing the bike, then football in the afternoon.
items.target: Painting the shed, fixing the bike, then football. Let's go!

items.prompt: Your manager asks if you can take on the new client. Which reply fits best?
options: Yes, I can take them on from the start of next week.
Absolutely, hand them over, I'll make a start this afternoon!
items.target: Absolutely, hand them over, I'll make a start this afternoon!

items.prompt: A housemate asks why you're up at six on a Sunday. Which reply fits best?
options: Couldn't stay in bed! Already run, showered, and into the list.
Couldn't sleep. Lay there for a while, then gave up on bed.
items.target: Couldn't stay in bed! Already run, showered, and into the list.

items.prompt: Your teammate asks how the morning standup went. Which reply fits best?
options: Sharp! Ten minutes, every task assigned, and the team already moving.
Lovely! Ten minutes, everyone smiling, and a good laugh at the end.
items.target: Sharp! Ten minutes, every task assigned, and the team already moving.

items.prompt: A friend asks how you're finding the new gym routine. Which reply fits best?
options: It suits me, I go at seven and keep an easy pace.
I'm hooked, in there at seven, pushing harder every day!
items.target: I'm hooked, in there at seven, pushing harder every day!

items.prompt: Your partner asks if you want to rest after the long drive. Which reply fits best?
options: No, I'm all right. I'll unpack the car now, then see.
Rest? No way, let's unpack the car and get to the beach!
items.target: Rest? No way, let's unpack the car and get to the beach!

items.prompt: A colleague asks about the hackathon this weekend. Which reply fits best?
options: Count me in, though I'm afraid my ideas won't hold up at all.
Count me in! I've got three ideas and I want to build them all.
items.target: Count me in! I've got three ideas and I want to build them all.

items.prompt: Your coach asks how the second half felt. Which reply fits best?
options: I was furious, so I ran at every ball like a madman.
I had so much left, I ran at every ball like a madman.
items.target: I had so much left, I ran at every ball like a madman.

items.prompt: A friend asks if you'll help with the move tomorrow. Which reply fits best?
options: Yes! I'll be there at eight, let's knock it out by lunch.
Yes, I can be there at eight and stay till lunch.
items.target: Yes! I'll be there at eight, let's knock it out by lunch.

items.prompt: Your boss asks how the first week of the launch went. Which reply fits best?
options: Smoothly. We kept a steady pace and kept things simple.
Flat out! We shipped three updates and we're pushing for more.
items.target: Flat out! We shipped three updates and we're pushing for more.

items.prompt: Your sister asks why you've signed up for a marathon. Which reply fits best?
options: Because I want a big goal to chase, and I'm itching to start!
Because running makes me so happy, I smile the whole way round!
items.target: Because I want a big goal to chase, and I'm itching to start!

items.prompt: A neighbour sees you clearing the garden at dawn and asks why. Which reply fits best?
options: Woke up full of go, so I'm clearing it before work!
The garden needed clearing, and the morning was free for it.
items.target: Woke up full of go, so I'm clearing it before work!

items.prompt: A colleague asks how you're feeling after the holiday. Which reply fits best?
options: Low. Coming back after the holiday has been really hard on me.
Recharged! I came back with a list of plans and I'm diving in.
items.target: Recharged! I came back with a list of plans and I'm diving in.

items.prompt: Your friend asks about the new business idea. Which reply fits best?
options: I'm building it, though I lie awake over what could fail.
I'm building it every evening and I can't wait to launch!
items.target: I'm building it every evening and I can't wait to launch!
